verdicts.decision_note: The proposed deliverables explicitly require configuring the MeetAlfred platform; the administrative timeline and milestone amount are not included in the Event payload.
The client explicitly identifies an unresolved MeetAlfred configuration choice between the Business and Pro subscription plans.
The client accepts the upgrade to the Pro plan, a platform configuration required to support the campaign integrations; no prior state key must be removed.
The client's acceptance of the Pro upgrade resolves the plan ambiguity and returns the platform-configuration Requirement to active status.
